```{r}
# Change this for YOUR results dir name
results_dir <- "hivprdimer_23119/" 
```

```{r}
# File names for all PDB models
pdb_files <- list.files(path="HIVPR_monomer_03c0b",
                        pattern="*.pdb",
                        full.names = TRUE)

# Print our PDB file names
basename(pdb_files)
```

```{r}
library(bio3d)

# Read all data from Models 
#  and superpose/fit coords
pdbs <- pdbaln(pdb_files, fit=TRUE, exefile="msa")

```

```{r}
# Read a reference PDB structure
pdb <- read.pdb("1hsg")
```

```{r}
plotb3(pdbs$b[1,], typ="l", lwd=2, sse=pdb)
points(pdbs$b[2,], typ="l", col="red")
points(pdbs$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
points(pdbs$b[4,], typ="l", col="darkgreen")
points(pdbs$b[5,], typ="l", col="orange")
abline(v=100, col="gray")
```

```{r}
core <- core.find(pdbs)

```
```{r}
core.inds <- print(core, vol=0.5)

```

```{r}
xyz <- pdbfit(pdbs, core.inds, outpath="corefit_structures")
```

calculate RMSF - how far apart each amino-acid is across all 5 AlphaFold models

```{r}
rf <- rmsf(pdbs$xyz)
plot.bio3d(rf)
```

### Residue Conservation

Read the AF MSA

```{r}


aln_file <- list.files(path="HIVPR_monomer_03c0b/",
                       pattern=".a3m$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
aln_file
aln <- read.fasta(aln_file[1], to.upper = TRUE)

```

```{r}
sim <- conserv(aln)

```

Plot this conservation result

```{r}
plot(sim, typ="h")
```

```{r}
con <- consensus(aln, cutoff = 0.9)
con$seq
```



\^ P .. DTGAD for 0.9 there will be D and G

### AF scores (pLDD & PAE score plots)

The pLDDT scores are stored in the PDB models "B-factor" col and in a separate JSON format file in the results directory. We can use either:

```{r}
plotb3(pdbs$b[1,], typ="l", lwd=2, sse=pdb)
points(pdbs$b[2,], typ="l", col="red")
points(pdbs$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
points(pdbs$b[4,], typ="l", col="darkgreen")
points(pdbs$b[5,], typ="l", col="orange")

#plot(m1.pdb$atom$b[m1.pdb$calpha], typ ="h")
```
